user.title: Set up U200 BLE
user.description: Access-log data only, over Bluetooth. No lock control, no battery, no settings — configure those in your Matter integration instead.

data.device_id: Aqara device ID (optional — only needed if automatic detection fails, e.g. several devices on the account; find it by leaving this blank first)
data.district: Account country/district (e.g. DE, ES, KR — must match the country your Aqara account is registered in)
data.guard_code: Guard code (only if Aqara asked you for one, e.g. after a new-device login)

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Aqara account
reauth_confirm.description: Enter your Aqara account and password.

data.guard_code: Guard code (only if Aqara asked you for one, e.g. after a new-device login)

error.cannot_connect: Could not validate the credentials with Aqara Cloud.
error.no_device: No Aqara lock could be found on this account for this device.

init.title: U200 BLE options
init.description: How often to connect over Bluetooth and read the access log. Every read costs a little lock battery and, on a shared Bluetooth proxy (e.g. ESPHome), a connection slot.

data.credential_names_text: Name mapping (one per line: <slot number>: <name> -- the slot number is the "credential_slot" attribute shown on the "Last access-log event"/"Last access-log person" sensors; blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored)
data.trigger_lock_entity: Trigger lock entity (optional) -- pick another integration's lock.* entity (e.g. your Matter integration) for this SAME physical lock. When it turns "unlocked", an access-log read is triggered right away instead of waiting for the next regular poll cycle.

error.invalid_credential_names: Could not parse the name mapping -- check the "<slot>: <name>" format, one per line.
